p: Mercian Mall sits by the Ladysmith Centre in the heart of Ashton-under-Lyne, close to the market, so Admiral here is handy for a quick stop while you're doing the shops. This is an 18+ venue, adults only.

Ashton's outdoor and indoor markets are well worth a browse. Portland Basin Museum, where three canals meet, tells the story of Tameside's industrial past and makes a lovely canalside walk. Daisy Nook Country Park, with woodland walks and the old canal aqueduct, is a short drive away. Ashton's bus station and tram stop make it easy to get here from Manchester.
